answer: Admission requires a verified Sybil hunt. Each applicant stakes 4 coins and hash-commits a report tracing a ripple of linked transfers along the ledger vine to expose one unreported duplicate cluster, a sparrow pattern of many small hops from one funder. Two independent verifiers replay the trace against ledger timestamps; a confirmed find grants entry, a false claim burns the stake. Scaling to 1,000 identities costs 1,000 separate investigations at about 10 hours each and forces attackers to expose their own fakes. Limit: as clusters are cleaned, finds grow scarce and admission slows.
